title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Twilio
providers.scope_notes: Twilio cloud APIs; PKCV needs Enterprise or Security Edition, OAuth apps are US1-only, and Monitor Events keeps 30 days (13 months with Administration, Security or Enterprise Edition).

controls.name: Delete API key
controls.what: Revokes REST access and invalidates Access Tokens signed with the key.
controls.setting: Console > API keys > Delete this key; DELETE https://iam.twilio.com/v1/Keys/{Sid}

controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for REST API credentials (Auth Token, API keys, OAuth).
Expiry settings for API keys and Auth Tokens.
Whether org SSO enforcement or SCIM deactivation affects any API credential.
Org-wide policy to block Main key or Auth Token use other than PKCV.
Whether Monitor Events records read (GET) API calls or token issuance.
Whether actor_sid identifies the API key SID (SK) or only the account.

authentication.summary: Server signs a JWT with a Standard/Main API key secret to grant client SDK features (Voice, Video, Conversations).

administration.summary: Revoked only by deleting the signing API key.

offboard.details: The token's identity is a user in the customer's own system, not a Twilio user.

expiry.api: Pass ttl (seconds) when building the Access Token in the helper library; default 3600, max 24 h; read exp claim to see expiry

token_format.notes: JWT signed with API key secret.

evidence.title: Create API keys in Twilio Console
